title: Vibe Desktop can edit the local repo. Linux is not out.
friendlyTitle: Vibe's desktop app can edit the project on your computer. Linux is not out yet.
summary: Mistral's desktop docs describe a coding app for macOS and Windows, with Linux still listed as coming soon. A session can run against a local repository or a cloud sandbox, and Git worktrees keep parallel tasks from writing over the same files. The Decoder reported the desktop release on 18 November.
friendlySummary: Mistral's docs describe a desktop coding app for Mac and Windows. Linux is still listed as coming soon. A job can use a project on your computer or a cloud sandbox. Separate work folders keep parallel jobs from overwriting the same files. The Decoder reported the desktop release on 18 November.
whyItMatters: Mistral says the desktop app does not require a separate command-line install, but tools and prompts can differ from the command-line version. Treat it like any coding agent. Set the approval rules before it edits a file or opens a pull request.
